title: Large Language Models Show Metacognitive Sensitivity in Medical Reasoning

live_model.evidence: Sec. 2.7: "The primary pilot reported here used gpt-4.1-nano, accessed through the OpenAI Responses API." Table 2 reports forced-choice accuracy 0.935.

prompt.location: Sec. 2.6 (3 prompt variants P01-P03, required JSON schema fields); full templates released in code repo
prompt.note: Structure and required JSON fields (diagnosis, confidence, more_information_needed) are described precisely; exact wording not quoted in the paper body.

data.source: Synthetic vignettes, prompts and code at https://github.com/anazz-dev/medical-llm-metacognition-benchmark

notes: Exploratory cross-model comparison (Table 8) also runs gpt-4.1-mini, gpt-5-nano, gpt-5, gpt-5.5 (all undated mentions) on the same 135-trial manifest; only gpt-4.1-nano is a clearly resolvable still-callable alias. Small single-author pilot (45 vignettes x 3 prompt variants).
